blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision language model (VLM) agents can control robots through visual feedback and action primitives, but repeated model invocations and redundant observations incur substantial token overhead. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework that couples feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation: the agent composes classical robot primitives and learned vision-language-action (VLA) policies into Python cells that perform conditional checks and local retries, returning only explicitly requested images and state feedback for replanning. Across 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365, we compare PyRUA-Lean with a tool-calling baseline using the same GPT-6 Astra planner and underlying robot primitives. Under equal LLM-call budgets, PyRUA-Lean increases overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%. On instances solved by both agents, it uses 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLM)代理能够通过视觉反馈和动作原始来控制机器人,但重复的模型引用和冗余的观察会引发大量的符号性间接费用. 我们引入了PyRUA-Lean,一个交互式的代码执行框架,将反馈驱动的原始成分与选择性的观察结合在一起: 代理人将古典机器人原始体和学习的视觉语言动作(VLA)政策编成Python细胞,进行有条件的检查和局部重试,只返回明确要求的图像和状态反馈用于重新规划. 来自LiBERO-PRO、RoboTwin 2.0和RoboCasa365的700个模拟任务实例, 我们用相同的GPT-6 Astra规划器和基础机器人原始物将PyRUA-Lean与工具调用基线进行比较。 在相等的LLM呼吁预算下,PyRUA-Lean将总体成功率从63.1%提高到71.7%。 在两个代理解决的案例中,它使用49%的LLM调用和65%的输入符.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can perform robot manipulation by interpreting visual observations and robot state, then invoking motion, perception, and grasping primitives, including vision-language-action (VLA) policies [ 1 , 10 , 33 , 26 ] . Their efficiency depends partly on how these primitives are exposed to the planner. In a tool-calling interface, an operation that depends on a previous tool’s result generally requires another VLM invocation. Intermediate results also accumulate in the conversation and are processed in subsequent calls; in systems such as RPent [ 33 ] , motion primitives automatically return multiple camera images at the end of each step of execution. Tasks requiring repeated localization, motion, and recovery can therefore incur substantial inference overhead, even when individual primitives are reliable.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)可以通过解释视觉观察和机器人状态来进行机器人操纵,然后引用运动,感知,并把握原始,包括视觉语言动作(VLA)政策[1,10,33,26]. 其效率部分取决于这些原始人是如何接触到规划者的. 在工具调用接口中,一个依赖于先前工具结果的操作一般需要再次使用VLM. 中间结果也在对话中积累,并在后续调用中进行处理;在RPent[33]等系统中,运动原始人会在每一步执行的结尾自动返回多个相机图像. 因此,即使个别原始人可靠,但需要反复本地化、运动和恢复的任务也会引起大量的推断费。

blocks.en: Executable code provides a way to reduce this overhead. A program can compose primitives, inspect their outputs, and execute conditional branches or retries before returning control to the VLM. Code-based robot control is well established: Code as Policies and ProgPrompt generate robot programs from language instructions [ 14 , 25 ] , while more recent systems incorporate execution feedback or refine programs across trials [ 9 , 16 ] . Outside robotics, code-based agent interfaces have also shown benefits in task completion and context efficiency [ 29 , 2 , 27 ] . These findings motivate our central question: how can a VLM agent compose robot primitives to reliably complete tasks while reducing token consumption through selective observation and context management?
blocks.zh: 可执行代码提供了一个减少这种间接费用的方法. 一个程序可以在返回控制到VLM之前,对原始人作曲,检查他们的输出,并执行有条件的分支或重试. 基于密码的机器人控制已经确立: 作为"政策与ProgPrompt"的代码从语言指令中生成机器人程序[14,25],而更近期的系统包含执行反馈或完善整个试验的程序[9,16]. 外部机器人,基于代码的代理接口也显示出任务完成和上下文效率的好处[29,2,27]. 这些发现激发了我们的中心问题: VLM 剂如何可以编造机器人原始人来可靠地完成任务,同时通过选择性的观察和上下文管理来减少象征性的消耗?

blocks.en:
We introduce PyRUA-Lean (Python for Lean Robot-Use Agents),
an interactive code-execution interface for feedback-driven
primitive composition and selective observation. The agent generates Python programs that compose robot primitives, check intermediate outcomes, and condition subsequent actions on execution feedback. Intermediate results remain available in a persistent program state, while only explicitly printed outputs and requested camera images are returned to the VLM. This allows the agent to handle intermediate execution steps without repeated model invocations and to control which observations enter its context.

blocks.en: PyRUA-Lean builds on RPent’s robot stacks and primitive implementations [ 33 ] . We compare it with RPent’s tool-calling agent under the same GPT-6 Astra planner, frozen VLA policies, evaluation task instances, and LLM-call budgets. Both agents operate without cross-episode memory. The comparison evaluates the interfaces as a whole, including their support for control flow, persistent program state, and observation delivery. Experiments cover 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365.

blocks.en:
Our contributions can be summarized as: • An interactive interface for robot primitive composition. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, a Python execution interface built on RPent’s
robot stack. It supports feedback-driven primitive composition,
persistent program state, and selective observation delivery. • Comprehensive evaluation on three robot benchmarks. Across 700 simulated instances, PyRUA-Lean improves overall success
by approximately 14% relative to tool calling. On jointly solved
instances, it uses 49% fewer VLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens. • Analysis of efficiency gains and limitations. Traces and ablations identify fewer LLM calls as the main source of token savings, which persist without VLA policies or operating guides but diminish on VLA-dominated tasks, and illustrate geometric computation and scripted recovery.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: VLM-based robot control. Language models have been used to select robot skills, interpret execution feedback, and generate motion commands. SayCan grounds skill selection in language instructions and learned affordances [ 1 ] , while Inner Monologue incorporates environment feedback into planning [ 10 ] . More recent systems support finer-grained control: Show-Harness exposes discrete semantic actions to a VLM [ 8 ] , and GPT-6 Astra has been evaluated as an embodied policy that generates or corrects robot actions [ 26 ] . VLA models provide learned visuomotor capabilities for language-conditioned control [ 4 , 13 , 3 , 23 ] . Harness VLA integrates frozen VLA policies with analytic primitives through RPent, a memory-guided agent framework [ 33 ] . PyRUA-Lean builds on RPent’s robot stacks and primitive implementations, exposing these capabilities through an interactive Python interface. We compare this interface with RPent’s tool-calling interface using the same planner and underlying primitives, with cross-episode memory disabled in both agents.
blocks.zh: VLM基于机器人控制. 语言模型被用于选择机器人技能,解释执行反馈,生成运动命令. SayCan在语言说明书中以技能选择为基础,并学会了支付能力[1],而Inner Monugue则将环境反馈纳入规划[10]. 较近期的系统支持精细的纹理控制 : Show-Harness将离散语义动作暴露于VLM[8],GPT-6 Astra被评价为一种体现的政策,生成或纠正机器人动作[26]. VLA模型为语言条件控制提供学习的粘度运动能力[4,13,3,23]. Harness VLA通过RPent将冻结的VLA政策与分析原始物融合,这是一个内存导剂框架[33]. PyRUA-Lean基于RPent的机器人堆栈和原始执行,通过互动的Python接口曝光这些能力. 我们使用相同的规划器和基础原始物来比较这个接口与RPent的工具调用接口,在两个代理物中都禁用跨集内存.

blocks.en: Code-based robot control. Code as Policies and ProgPrompt generate executable robot programs from language instructions [ 14 , 25 ] , while VoxPoser generates code that constructs spatial value maps for motion planning [ 11 ] . Subsequent work explores execution feedback and program adaptation. CaP-X benchmarks coding agents across primitive abstraction levels and single- or multi-turn interaction modes [ 9 ] , and VLCP periodically regenerates a control function from updated observations within an episode [ 17 ] . Other systems accumulate reusable capabilities across trials: Voyager develops a code-based skill library in Minecraft [ 28 ] , ASPIRE refines robot programs and consolidates experience into reusable skills [ 16 ] , and RoboRSI converts established tool-use workflows into executable routines as part of a robot self-improvement system [ 19 ] . These studies establish program synthesis, feedback-driven execution, and skill reuse as complementary approaches to embodied control. Our focus is the success and inference cost of interactive code execution relative to tool calling over the same robot primitives, including VLA policies. We evaluate this comparison without cross-episode skill accumulation, while allowing state and code reuse within each episode.
blocks.zh: 基于密码的机器人控制. 代码为Policy and ProgPrompt从语言指令生成可执行的机器人程序[14,25],而VoxPoser则生成构建空间值地图用于运动规划的代码[11]. 随后的工作探索了执行反馈和程序调整. CaP-X基准编码剂跨越原始抽象水平和单回合或多回合交互模式[9],VLCP定期从一集[17]内更新的观测中重新生成一个控制函数. 其他系统在整个审判过程中积累可重复使用的能力: Voyager在Minecraft [28] 开发一个基于代码的技巧库,ASPIRE将机器人程序精炼,将经验整合为可重复使用的技能[16],RoboRSI将既定的工具使用工作流程转换为可执行的常规,作为机器人自我改进系统的一部分[19]. 这些研究将方案综合、反馈驱动的执行和技能再利用确定为体现控制的补充方法。 我们的焦点是交互代码执行的成功和推论成本 相对于工具调用相同的机器人原始,包括VLA政策。 我们评价这种比较时没有跨集的技能积累,同时允许在每集内进行状态和代码的再利用.

blocks.en: Code-based interfaces for efficient agents. Research on general-purpose agents provides a broader motivation for this comparison. ReAct interleaves reasoning with environment interaction [ 32 ] , and Toolformer studies the use of external APIs by language models [ 24 ] . CodeAct shows that executable Python can improve agent performance relative to text or JSON action interfaces [ 29 ] , while SWE-agent demonstrates the importance of interface design for software-engineering agents [ 31 ] . More recent systems use code to compose tool calls and process intermediate results outside the model context, reducing the information returned to the VLM [ 2 , 27 ] . PyRUA-Lean applies these interface principles to robot manipulation, where observations are visual and primitive execution may fail. We measure task success together with LLM-call usage, input-token consumption, and inference cost, and analyze how programmatic composition and observation passing contribute to the gains.
blocks.zh: 高效代理的基于代码接口. 对普通用途物剂的研究为这种比较提供了更广泛的动力。 ReAct Interleaves 推理与环境交互 [32], Toolformer研究语言模型对外部API的使用 [24]. CodeAct显示,可执行的Python可以相对于文本或JSON动作接口改善代理性能[29],而SWE代理则证明了界面设计对于软件工程代理[31]的重要性. 较近期的系统使用代码来编译工具调用和处理模型上下文以外的中间结果,减少返回到VLM[2,27]的信息. PyRUA-Lean将这些接口原理应用于机器人操纵,其中的观测是视觉的,原始的处决可能失败. 我们结合LLM调用、输入式消耗和推论成本衡量任务的成功,并分析方案组成和观察的通过如何促进成果。

blocks.en: 3 PyRUA-Lean: Primitive Composition with Selective Observation
blocks.zh: 3 PyRUA-Lean:带有选择性观测的初级组成

blocks.en: PyRUA-Lean is an interactive code-execution interface for VLM-based robot agents. It supports two complementary mechanisms: composing robot primitives into programs that respond to execution feedback, and controlling which intermediate results and visual observations enter the VLM context. The interface builds on RPent’s robot stacks and primitive implementations [ 33 ] , including classical motion and perception primitives and learned VLA policies.
blocks.zh: PyRUA-Lean是一个基于VLM的机器人代理的交互式代码执行界面. 它支持两个互补机制:将机器人原始人编组成响应执行反馈的程序,以及控制哪些中间结果和视觉观测进入VLM背景. 该界面基于RPent的机器人堆栈和原始执行[33],包括古典运动和感知原始以及学习的VLA政策.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : PyRUA-Lean combines primitive composition with selective feedback. (a) The tool-calling agent invokes robot primitives through tool calls. Operations that depend on preceding results generally require another VLM turn, and motion calls automatically return images and state. (b) PyRUA-Lean instead generates Python cells that compose robot primitives with helper functions, conditional checks, and local retries. Intermediate execution stays within the runtime, while explicitly requested images and state messages are recorded and returned at cell end for replanning. (c) A recorded placement example illustrates both mechanisms: one PyRUA-Lean cell replaces baseline steps 14–17, reducing four LLM turns to one. The cell computes a placement target from scene geometry (compose), conditionally executes lowering and release (compose), and requests an image only if the task remains unfinished (select). This successful execution returns five printed lines and no image, demonstrating how programmatic composition and selective feedback reduce repeated model interaction. Appendix A follows the whole episode.
blocks.zh: 图2 PyRUA-Lean将原始成分与选择性反馈相结合. (a) 工具调用代理通过工具调用引用机器人原始语。 依赖于先前结果的操作一般需要另一个VLM转弯,运动调用自动返回图像和状态. (b) PyRUA-Lean生成 Python细胞编曲机器人原始体,具有帮助器功能,有条件检查,以及局部重试. 中间执行停留在运行时间之内,同时明确要求的图像和状态消息会被记录,并在单元格端返回以重新规划. (c) 一个有记录的放置示例说明了这两种机制:一个PyRUA-Lean细胞取代基线步骤14-17,将四个LLM变为一个。 单元格从场景几何(组成)计算一个放置目标,有条件地执行降低和释放(组成),只有在任务仍未完成(选择)时才请求图像. 这一成功执行返回了5条打印行,没有图像,表明程序构成和选择性反馈如何减少重复的模型交互. 附 录 A跟随整个剧集.

blocks.en: 3.1 Robot Interface and Execution Model
blocks.zh: 3.1 机器人接口和执行模型

blocks.en: The robot is exposed as a Python object, robo , whose methods invoke primitives and return structured results, such as object positions and motion outcomes. The agent receives an API reference (Table 1 lists the primitives) and interacts with the robot through a python(code) tool. At each interaction, the VLM generates a code cell, the runtime executes it, and the returned feedback informs the next code cell. A persistent Python namespace retains variables and helper functions across cells within an episode. Our evaluation uses no cross-episode memory.
blocks.zh: 该机器人作为Python对象robo 暴露,其方法引用原始物并返回结构化的结果,如物体位置和运动结果. 代理接收API参考(表1列出原始人),并通过python(代码)工具与机器人互动. 在每次互动时,VLM生成一个代码单元格,运行时间执行,返回的反馈通知下一个代码单元格. 一个持久的 Python 命名空间在一个插曲内保留了跨单元格的变量和辅助函数. 我们的评价没有使用跨集的记忆。

blocks.en: An uncaught exception terminates the current cell and returns its traceback to the VLM. Variables assigned before the exception remain in the persistent namespace, allowing the agent to revise the failed operation in a subsequent cell. Before each primitive that acts on the robot, the runtime terminates the cell if the task has already succeeded. An external watchdog enforces the two-hour episode limit by interrupting any active primitive and stopping the planner. We impose no separate per-cell execution limit; in our setup, the Codex CLI returns a tool-call timeout after 300 s without cancelling the cell, and subsequent cells are queued.
blocks.zh: 一个未发现的例外会终止当前单元格,并返回其可追溯到VLM. 例外之前指定的变量仍然停留在持续命名空间中,允许代理在后续单元格中修改失败的操作. 在每个对机器人起作用的原始人之前,如果任务已经成功,运行时间会终止细胞. 一个外部监督员通过打断任何活跃的原始,阻止规划者,强制执行两小时的剧集限制. 我们没有规定单独的每个细胞执行限制;在我们的设置中,Codex CLI在300s后返回一个工具调用超时而不取消单元格,随后的单元格会被排队.

blocks.en: 3.2 Feedback-Driven Primitive Composition
blocks.zh: 3.2 反馈驱动的初级构成

blocks.en: Each cell can compose multiple primitives and condition subsequent operations on their outcomes. For example, a program may approach an object, attempt a grasp only if the approach succeeds, and retry or stop based on the resulting state. These checks and branches execute within the cell without additional LLM invocations. At the end of the cell, the returned feedback allows the LLM to revise subsequent actions, combining program-level feedback with LLM-level replanning.
blocks.zh: 每个细胞可以组成多个原始体,并以它们的结果作为后续操作的条件. 例如,一个程序可以接近一个对象,只有在该方法成功时才尝试抓取,然后根据结果状态重试或停止. 这些检查和分支在单元格中执行,不需要额外的LLM引用. 在单元格末尾,返回的反馈允许LLM修改后续动作,将程序级反馈与LLM级重新规划相结合.

blocks.en: Beyond composing primitive calls, programs can compose task-specific computations and control routines from existing observations and primitives, as illustrated by the geometric computation in Figure 2 (c). For example, the agent computes the bowl’s base height from a world-coordinate map to determine a placement target that no individual primitive directly returns. It can also define helper functions for repeated operations, such as a guarded descent. Computed values and helper functions remain available to later cells through the persistent namespace.
blocks.zh: 除了编组原始调用,程序还可以从现有的观测和原始数据中编组任务特定计算和控制常规,如图2(c)中的几何计算所示. 例如,代理人从一个世界坐标图计算碗底高度,以确定一个没有个人原始直接返回的放置目标。 它还可以定义重复操作的帮助者功能,例如被守护的下降. 计算值和帮助函数仍然通过持久命名空间提供给以后的单元格。

blocks.en: 3.3 Selective Observation and Context Management
blocks.zh: 3.3 选择性观察和背景管理

blocks.en:
Primitive results remain available in the runtime without being individually added to the LLM conversation. The agent specifies which feedback to return through explicit output statements and camera requests such as robo.show . Requested images and state messages are recorded at the points specified in the code and returned together at the end of the cell.
In the episode summarized in Appendix A , cell 5 requests a camera image after transporting the bowl. The placement cell shown in Figure 2 (c) requests an image only if the task remains unfinished and therefore returns no images after successful placement.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 实验结果和分析

blocks.en: Our central question is whether a VLM agent can compose robot primitives to improve task completion while reducing token overhead through programmatic execution and selective feedback. We evaluate PyRUA-Lean against a tool-calling baseline through three hypotheses ( H ):
blocks.zh: 我们的中心问题是 VLM 代理 是否可以编程机器人原始人来改进任务完成,同时通过程序执行和选择性反馈来减少象征性的间接费用. 我们通过三种假设(H),根据工具调用基准评估PyRUA-Lean:

blocks.en: • H1: PyRUA-Lean achieves higher task success than tool calling under equal LLM-call budgets. • H2: PyRUA-Lean requires fewer LLM calls and input tokens to solve tasks. • H3: PyRUA-Lean retains its token efficiency when VLA policies or operating guides are absent.

blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate 40 tasks from LIBERO-PRO’s four perturbed suites [ 34 , 15 ] , 50 dual-arm tasks from RoboTwin 2.0 [ 6 ] , and 50 tasks from RoboCasa365’s Target50 set [ 18 ] . Each task is evaluated at five environment seeds, with one episode per agent for each task–seed pair, yielding 700 paired task instances and 1,400 episodes. More implementation details can be found in Appendix F .

blocks.en: 4.2 Task Success and Inference Cost
blocks.zh: 4.2 任务成功和推论成本

blocks.en: Task success improves across all benchmark groups. Table 2 shows that PyRUA-Lean increases overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%, an improvement of 8.6 percentage points, or approximately 14% relative. The gains are 11.0 points on LIBERO-PRO, 9.2 on RoboTwin 2.0, 7.8 on RoboCasa365 atomic tasks, and 5.0 on composite tasks. PyRUA-Lean alone solves 96 instances, whereas tool calling alone solves 36. These results support Hypothesis 1 within the evaluated setting: PyRUA-Lean completes more tasks under the same LLM-call budget. Figure 4 illustrates a recovery example in which PyRUA-Lean uses geometric computation to reposition a dropped object and complete the task. Appendix D provides further analysis of instances solved by only one agent.
blocks.zh: 在所有基准组中,任务的成功得到改善。 表2显示,PyRUA-Lean公司的总体成功率从63.1%提高到71.7%,提高了8.6个百分点,即相对大约14%。 在LIBERO-PRO、RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa365原子任务和5.0复合任务上取得了11.0分的进展。 PyRUA-Lean单独解决96例,而工具单独调用则解决36例. 这些结果支持在评价范围内的假设1: PyRUA-Lean在相同的LLM调用预算下完成更多的任务. 图4说明了PyRUA-Lean使用几何计算重新定位一个掉落对象并完成任务的回收实例. 附 录 D进一步分析了只有一个代理人解决的案件。

blocks.en: Completing the same tasks requires fewer calls and tokens. On jointly solved instances, PyRUA-Lean reduces mean LLM calls from 17.0 to 8.7 and input tokens from 788k to 276k, corresponding to reductions of 49% and 65%. Estimated cost decreases from $1.63 to $0.74 per episode. The smaller monetary reduction reflects, in part, caching discounts on the baseline’s repeatedly processed history. These findings support Hypothesis 2 and show that the higher overall success rate is accompanied by lower inference overhead on shared successes. The pooled token reduction is influenced strongly by LIBERO-PRO’s longer episodes; per-benchmark results are therefore also reported.
blocks.zh: 完成同样的任务需要较少的电话和信使. 在共同解决的案例中,PyRUA-Lean将LLM电话从17.0减少到8.7,输入符从788k减少到276k,相当于减少49%和65%。 估计费用从每集1.63美元降至0.74美元。 数额较小的货币减少部分反映了基线多次加工历史的缓冲折扣。 这些结论支持假设2,并表明总体成功率较高的同时,对共同成功率的推论间接费用较低。 集合指数减少受到LIBERO-PRO较长事件的影响很大;因此,每个基准结果也得到报告。

blocks.en: Figure 3 complements this comparison with retrospective token-budget cutoffs on recorded trajectories. On LIBERO-PRO, PyRUA-Lean reaches the baseline’s final success rate with 564k tokens per episode, compared with 3.18M for tool calling. This connects success and efficiency beyond the jointly solved subset, although the agents were not rerun with these token budgets specified beforehand.
blocks.zh: 图3补充了记录轨迹的追溯性象征性预算截断。 在LiBERO-PRO上,PyRUA-Lean以每集564k个令牌达到基线的最终成功率,而工具调用则达到3.18M. 这与联合解决子集之外的成功和效率有关,尽管这些代理人没有与事先指定的这些象征性预算重新运行。

blocks.en: RoboDojo pilot. We additionally compare RPent-adapted and PyRUA-Lean-adapted on three RoboDojo [ 7 ] tasks: cover blocks , press by number , and stack blocks by language —using the same GPT-6 Astra planner with identical task-agnostic primitives. PyRUA-Lean achieves 26.7% success (8/30) versus 3.4% (1/29 scored; one infrastructure failure excluded); both fail button pressing. Total input and output tokens across all attempts per success decrease from 11.56M to 1.07M (90.7%), while total-token usage on 29 matched scored pairs falls by 25.3%.
blocks.zh: 机械道场飞行员. 我们还比较了三个RoboDojo[7]任务上的RPent适应和PyRUA-Lean适应:覆盖块、按数字、按语言排列的堆积块——使用相同的GPT-6 Astra规划器和相同的任务不可知原始物。 PyRUA-Lean取得了26.7%的成功(8/30),对3.4%(1/29分;不包括一个基础设施故障);两个故障按钮都按下。 在所有成功尝试中,总投入和产出指数从11.56M下降到1.07M(90.7%),而29对对应得分的总使用量下降了25.3%。

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis of LLM Calls and Observation Feedback
blocks.zh: 4.3 对LLM呼叫和观测反馈的分析

blocks.en: Fewer VLM invocations account for most of the token reduction. Figure 5 decomposes the token ratio into the LLM-call ratio and the ratio of average input tokens per call. On LIBERO-PRO, the 4.48 × 4.48\times token ratio comprises 2.55 × 2.55\times fewer calls and 1.76 × 1.76\times fewer tokens per call. On RoboCasa365 atomic tasks, PyRUA-Lean’s calls are larger on average, yet fewer invocations still reduce total token usage. Thus, Hypothesis 2 is supported primarily by reducing how often the VLM is invoked, rather than uniformly making each prompt smaller.
blocks.zh: 比较少的VLM引用占了符号减少的大部分. 图5将符号比例分解为LLM调用比例和每调用的平均输入符号比例. 在LIBERO-PRO上,4.48×4.48\时令牌比例包括2.55×2.55\时令牌数量减少,1.76×1.76\时令牌数量减少. 在RoboCasa365原子任务上,PyRUA-Lean的呼声平均较大,但引用的次数较少,仍然减少了总的象征性使用。 因此,假设2主要是通过减少使用VLM的频率,而不是统一使每个提示变小来支持的.

blocks.en: Execution traces illustrate how programmatic composition enables this reduction. A cell can execute dependent motions, check their outcomes, and retry a primitive before returning control to the VLM. In the bowl-placement example, the agent also computes placement geometry directly from observations. These behaviors address the central research question by moving intermediate coordination and computation into the execution runtime. The token decomposition is an accounting analysis, however, and does not independently isolate the causal contribution of each interface feature.
blocks.zh: 执行痕迹说明方案构成如何促成这种减少。 一个细胞可以执行依附运动,检查其结果,在返回控制到VLM之前重试一个原始. 在碗置位例子中,剂也直接从观测中计算放置几何. 这些行为通过将中间协调和计算移入执行运行时间来解决中央研究问题. 然而,令牌分解是一种会计分析,并不独立孤立每个界面特征的因果贡献.

blocks.en: On-demand images alone do not reproduce the gains. On LIBERO-PRO, we additionally modify the tool-calling baseline to return images only on request. As shown in Table 8 , success decreases from 83.0% to 68.5%. On the 131 instances solved by all three configurations, the modified baseline makes more calls and consumes approximately the same total input tokens as the original baseline. This suggests that reducing automatic visual feedback alone is insufficient: observation requests must be considered together with action execution and replanning. The experiment does not separately quantify the contribution of selective feedback within PyRUA-Lean.
blocks.zh: 仅凭点播图像并不能复制收益。 在LIBERO-PRO上,我们额外修改了工具调用基线,只根据请求返回图像. 如表8所示,成功率从83.0%降至68.5%。 在全部三种配置解决的131个实例中,修改后的基线会发出更多的呼叫,消耗的总输入符与原始基准大致相同. 这表明仅减少自动视觉反馈是不够的:观察请求必须与行动执行和重新规划一并考虑。 实验没有单独量化PyRUA-Lean内部选择性反馈的贡献.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: Token savings persist without VLA policies or guides. We remove VLA policies, operating guides, or both from each agent on the same task instances; RoboCasa365 has no guides, so only VLA policies are ablated. Across these settings, PyRUA-Lean maintains higher overall success and lower input-token usage on jointly solved instances (Table 3 ), supporting Hypothesis 3. Without VLA policies, it achieves 68.8% success on RoboTwin 2.0 versus 42.8% for tool calling, with traces showing classical primitives composed into approach, gripper control, and state checks.
blocks.zh: 没有志愿军政策或指南,节省的资金依然存在。 我们取消了志愿军政策、操作指南,或者在相同任务情况下从每个代理人中取消;RoboCasa365没有指南,因此只有志愿军政策被取消。 在这些设置中,PyRUA-Lean在共同解析实例上保持较高的整体成功率和较低的输入语汇使用率(表3),支持假说3. 没有VLA政策,在RoboTwin 2.0上取得了68.8%的成功,而在工具调用上则取得了42.8%的成功,有痕迹显示古典原始人组成了方法,握手控制和州检.

blocks.en: Guidance has interface-dependent effects. On RoboTwin 2.0 without VLA policies, removing guides increases tool-calling success from 42.8% to 60.4%, suggesting that guidance is not uniformly beneficial. Jointly solved subsets also vary across settings, so their token costs do not isolate component effects on a fixed task subset.
blocks.zh: 指导具有界面依赖效应. 在没有VLA政策的RoboTwin 2.0上,删除指南将工具调用成功率从42.8%提高到60.4%,这表明指导并非统一有益. 联合解决的子集也因设置而异,因此它们的符号成本不会孤立组件对固定任务子集的影响.

blocks.en: 4.5 Failure Cases and Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.5 失败案件和限制

blocks.en: Improved budget use explains some, but not all, additional successes. Of the 96 instances solved only by PyRUA-Lean, the baseline exhausts its LLM-call budget in 52 and ends unsuccessfully before exhausting it in 44. The former cases are consistent with programmatic composition enabling more execution within the budget. The latter include examples of geometric reasoning and scripted recovery, but also cases where a VLA succeeds in one run and fails in the other. The success difference therefore cannot be attributed entirely to better recovery logic.
blocks.zh: 预算使用情况的改善是取得一些而不是全部额外成功的原因。 在仅由PyRUA-Lean公司解决的96起案件中,基线在52起案件中耗尽了LLM调用预算,在44起案件中耗尽前没有成功。 前一种情况与方案组成一致,使预算得以更多执行。 后者包括几何推理和脚本恢复的例子,但也包括VLA在一次运行中成功,另一次运行失败的情况. 因此,成功差异不能完全归因于更好的恢复逻辑。

blocks.en: Efficiency gains depend on task structure and failures. Gains are smallest on RoboCasa365 atomic tasks, where a VLA policy often completes most of the task and the initial prompt accounts for much of the input. PyRUA-Lean’s larger API description can offset part of the benefit from fewer calls. Including failed episodes, the estimated VLM inference cost of tool calling on RoboCasa365 atomic tasks is approximately 1.1 times that of PyRUA-Lean (Appendix E ). Efficiency on jointly solved instances should therefore be distinguished from the cost of all attempts.
blocks.zh: 增效取决于任务结构和失败。 在RoboCasa365原子任务上,收益最小,其中VLA政策常常完成大部分任务,初始即时占了大部分投入. PyRUA-Lean的更大API描述可以抵消较少通话的部分好处. 包括失败事件,调用RoboCasa365原子任务的工具的估计VLM推导成本约为PyRUA-Lean(附录E)的1.1倍. 因此,应区分联合解决案件的效率与所有尝试的成本。

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Our evaluation is limited to GPT-6 Astra, RPent’s robot stacks and primitive libraries, and simulation, with one run per agent per task instance. Generalization to other planners and primitive configurations, variability across repeated runs, and physical-robot performance remain untested. The comparison evaluates the complete interfaces without fully isolating the effects of primitive composition, persistent state, and selective feedback. Future work will address these limitations, measure execution latency and recovery on physical robots, and examine how primitive granularity and cross-episode reuse of validated routines affect success, inference cost, and adaptability.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价仅限于GPT-6 Astra、RPent的机器人堆栈和原始库以及模拟,每个任务实例每个代理都运行一次。 通向其他规划者和原始配置,反复运行的变异性,以及物理机器人的性能仍未经过测试. 比较评价完整的界面时没有完全隔离原始成分,持续状态和选择性反馈的影响. 今后的工作将解决这些限制,衡量执行时间和对物理机器人的恢复,并审查原始颗粒性和对经过验证的常规的跨集复用如何影响成功、推论成本和适应性。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution interface that composes existing robot primitives, including VLA policies, and controls which execution feedback enters the LLM context. Across 700 simulated task instances, PyRUA-Lean outperforms a tool-calling baseline using the same GPT-6 Astra planner and underlying primitives under equal LLM-call budgets, increasing overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%. On instances solved by both agents, it uses 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens. Fewer LLM invocations account for most of the token savings, with smaller gains on VLA-dominated tasks. These results demonstrate the value of programmatic primitive composition and motivate further study of feedback management in robot agents.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了PyRUA-Lean,一个交互式的代码执行界面,它构成现有的机器人原始,包括VLA政策,以及执行反馈进入LLM背景的控制. 在700个模拟任务实例中,PyRUA-Lean在使用相同的GPT-6 Astra规划器和在LLM-调用预算下的基本原始物时,超过了工具调用基准,总体成功率从63.1%提高到71.7%。 在两个代理解决的案例中,它使用49%的LLM调用和65%的输入符. 较少的LLM引用占了大部分象征性节省,在VLA主导任务上的收益较小. 这些结果表明了程序原始成分的价值,并激励了对机器人剂反馈管理的进一步研究.
